name: Browse project context and attach a document to an agent
description: From the app root, open Project Context for the seeded repo, confirm the fixture clone's four markdown documents are discovered, preview specs/idempotency-keys.md and assert a literal line of its body, then open the Security Reviewer agent's Context tab, attach that document, and confirm the attached/total badge and the token-estimate footer. Returns to Project Context to confirm the document now reports the agent that reaches it, which proves the attachment round-tripped through the API. Finally opens PR #482's seeded run in the trace drawer and asserts the injected path under 'Specs read' plus the 'Project context — attached specs (untrusted)' prompt segment carrying the document body as sent. NOTE — the drawer shows specs/idempotency-keys.md as injected while the agent had nothing attached when this flow began, and that is correct rather than a contradiction: a run_traces row is a frozen historical artifact of a past run, and the seed deliberately leaves agent_docs empty, which is what keeps the '0 attached' assertion above true. Exercises the repo-scoped context route, the document preview, the agent Context tab, the used_by_agents reverse lookup and the run-trace drawer. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo and carries both the fixture clone and the fixture run (see e2e/README.md).
